decision.summaryForCoordinator: The three protected DR-124 leftovers are not stolen, and I checked that in both directions rather than reading the disclaimers: the subject carries none of the three ids, and state-class-leftover-join.v2 still holds OBL-GRANT-JOURNAL, OBL-INHERIT-BLOCKED and OBL-MONOTONIC at leftoverDesign true with all three still in its own summary bucket. What the subject carries instead is OBL-DR124-LEFTOVER-NOT-STOLEN, a distinct id in the deferredOrRidesElsewhere bucket riding DR-124. Nothing is invented either — every occurrence of grant-journal, inherit-blocked, monotonic and sealed-Run is inside a negation, the row-join role, or the open-standing sentence, no structure or bound is described, and the complete bare-integer set is 1, 5, 08 and 26, so no window value or sequence number exists because no number is available to be one. One check worth naming: the first corpus member is 'state-class × migration/backup/purge/recovery matrix', where the separator is U+00D7, not ASCII 'x'. That is exactly the string a hand-copy degrades, and a reader comparing by eye would not catch it, so I compared at byte level — live harness, both of the subject's copies, and the catalog are all byte-identical, and live DR-G19 cell [2] carries both classes in the same order. A method note: the two fields the artifact leans on hardest, leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded and leftoverNameNote, are not top-level keys of G19 v1 — both sit under /whatThisCloses, and a shallow scan reports them absent and manufactures a confident blocker. Read at the right depth, both say exactly what the subject says, including the recorded gap 'No leftover-join artifact for this gate exists' that justifies this file. The status token is DR-G19's own cell [7] OPEN; DR-124 is also OPEN, so the value alone cannot distinguish them and the artifact separates them by origin instead, which I verified on both limbs. Live DR-G19 corroborates the claim, the corpus order, the owner 'Semantic + evidence + storage', and 'PROPOSED; not QUALIFIED'. All sixteen cited digests match, partition is exact at five obligations with OBL-G19-FX-AUTHORING the single true flag, and the subject did not move.
